title: Hermeus header
description: A transparent bar over the hero: a bold tracked wordmark at the left and seven small uppercase links spread at the right (a thin hamburger on phones). It sticks to the top while the first screens scroll by and is pushed away when its wrapper ends. Links turn amber on hover; the hamburger opens a full-screen grey menu of large capitals.
notes: sticky and in the flow: put it in a wrapper with the first sections and pull the next one up under it (-mt-[3.625rem] lg:-mt-[5.875rem]), as page.tsx does
needs JavaScript (hydrate: load) for the phone menu; static HTML shows the bar
transparent: its labels use secondary-foreground, so it reads on the theme's secondary ground
name: hermeus-header
